BOOT.strategy: detour the call; run BOOT handlers after setup() returns, once
BOOT.note: fires a single time, right before the main loop begins

TICK.strategy: detour the call; run TICK handlers each frame, then call loop()
TICK.note: entire M8 application frame; descend into loop() for RENDER/INPUT

notes: yield (0x600B4DC0) is a long-branch veneer to the real yield().
UI strings are accessed by computed index with no static xref; RENDER/AUDIO
hooks require descending into loop()'s subsystems in Ghidra, not string xrefs.

0x600585C2.note: INST. MODS loads the DEST field under the cursor into view+0xC: byte & 0xF (view r5, modulator x6 r4). Model:02: the same instructions at 0x600585C2 (headless 0x60056F9A)

0x60058C0C.note: the DEST editor, after clamping to count-1, masks the value to 4 bits before bic/orr into the packed byte (view r4, modulator r5). Model:02: the same instructions at 0x60058C0C (headless 0x600575E4)

0x60058110.note: INST. MODS draws a DEST: byte & 0xF, then the engine's name(dest) (model sl: instrument at +0xC; modulator r6). Model:02: the same instructions at 0x60058110 (headless 0x60056AE8)

0x60054EC4.note: the instrument randomizer (action 0xE5): dest = rand() % count, ORed into the packed byte unmasked. Model:02: the same instructions at 0x60054EC4 (headless 0x600537F4)

0x60058334.note: INST. MODS copies a modulator (SHIFT+OPT): its 6 bytes to view+0xD, +0x14 = 0xFE (view r5, modulator r4). Model:02: the same instructions at 0x60058334 (headless 0x60056D0C)

0x60058876.note: INST. MODS pastes a modulator (SHIFT+EDIT): after the first 4 bytes are written (view r4, modulator x6 r6). Model:02: the same instructions at 0x60058876 (headless 0x6005724E)

0x6004B620.note: frame refresh 0x6004B514, the visualizer branch (taken while display+4, 0x200137FC, is set): after the eight tracks' draw (0x6004A64A each), the clip column grid+0x12EA is put back, then the frame is pushed by a tail call (0x6004B636). Reached from the loop's end and its early exit (0x6004B616 cbnz -> 0x6004B61E). r6 = fw_grid (0x20012464), the drawing context

loader.note: core 0.5 for Model:02, from the headless core's sites found again in 6.6.2A (code matched by instruction runs, data through the literals the matched code loads; the map with its evidence: docs/MODEL02-PORT.md). Free flash past the image (ends 0x601EB000) up to the EEPROM emulation at 0x60FC0000; the ITCM tail after the firmware's ITCM code (0x2B8D0). Runs on a Model:02 (2026-11-17).
